ref: ADR-0008 "JSON as a source at run time" (null is no array, so it reads as absent even with "null" in the type list) and GLOSSARY "Array property"; #118
note: PO message mappings have no JSON source, so the reading is decided. $/maybe is typed ["array", "null"] with maxItems 1: a nillable array property at 0..1. Its value is null, which is no array, so maybe never occurs and no All is written. Read by its maximum, maybe would be a nillable leaf, null would read as the empty string and an empty All would be written.
